messages:
jasmine: Heads-up — planning private-VPC installer cutover tomorrow 22:00 UTC. Need final packaging + deploybot window signoff. Do we pin images or allow fallback?

matt: I can be oncall for the cutover. what's the release tag?

jasmine: tag is v1.4.2-private-20260322. Packaging will produce shrinkwrap + cosign. signer TTL might be tight (see below).

deploybot: deploybot: request scheduled: 2026-03-22T22:00Z window. will create canary at +5m, full rollout at +15m. Command preview:
```
/deploy start v1.4.2-private --env private --canary 5% --auto-rollout 10m
```

sarah: For rollback we should have a clear play: unpin manifest, route traffic back to v1.4.1-private, and kill canary. I'll draft a 1-pager.

omar: Packaging note: signer_id=key-prod-7 expiry=2026-03-22T01:00Z (UTC) — that looks like it would expire before our window unless rotated.

jasmine: ugh — good catch. ops, can we extend signer TTL or re-sign at canary time?

sre-oncall: @omar we recommend re-signing just before handoff. If signer rotation can't be guaranteed, fallback to the pre-signed offline artifact.

deploybot: deploybot: FYI pinning behavior:
- pin-manifest to sha256 will disable automatic fallback to previous manifest.
- use `--allow-fallback` to enable rollback routing.

matt: Proposal: don't pin the live manifest. Produce a pinned-offline artifact for airgap delivery (sha256 pinned) but allow fallback for the public manifest. jasmine ok with that?

jasmine: agree. packaging produce two deliverables: `v1.4.2-private-pinned-offline.tgz` + `v1.4.2-private-live-manifest` (allow fallback). I'll update release notes to call out signer TTL and handoff steps.

sarah: Draft playbook snippet for quick copy/paste:
```yaml
# rollback snippet
steps:
  - name: abort-canary
    run: /deploy abort --canary v1.4.2-private
  - name: rollback
    run: /deploy rollback v1.4.1-private --force
```

omar: Canary criteria: 5% traffic for 10m, abort if error-rate > 2% or 5xx spike, or avg latency +200ms over baseline. Also watch cosign verification logs during handoff.

matt: Add manual holdback at T+12m to evaluate, and set deploybot abort threshold to 2% errors.

deploybot: deploybot: scheduled by jasmine at 3609812345 — status: queued. Will post canary/start events in-channel.

jasmine: thanks all. i'll run final cosign/verify immediately before handoff and tag the release notes. tagging: @sre-oncall @matt @omar @sarah :thumbsup:

sarah: I'll take the postmortem checklist if anything tripped — will also add a short troubleshooting list to the release notes (KMS sign, cosign mismatch, transport checksum).

matt: ack. see you in the window.

jasmine: closing loop — packaging will upload both artifacts and send manifest link when ready. will ping again 1h before window.
